verdict.rationale: Abacum documents a dedicated headcount-planning use case where headcount is planned, approved and forecast in the same connected model as the budget, so hires flow into the financial plan. It also supports per-hire planning via HRIS integration, and scenarios move hiring together with revenue and cash. missing for 10: explicit role-level planning granularity, explicit tie-in to payroll actuals (only an HRIS connection is evidenced), detailed docs on how planned hires map to expense lines, independent or hands-on corroboration.
